descriptions.w3d_d24g_camera_jetpack_actions_80056178: Appends input actions to the owner's pointer vector at +36: Camera.RotateLeftPressed (3, 1, axis 1), Camera.RotateLeftReleased (3, 0, axis 1), Camera.RotateRightPressed (3, 1, axis 2), Camera.RotateRightReleased (3, 0, axis 2), Camera.RotateDownPressed (4, 1, axis 1), Camera.RotateDownReleased (4, 0, axis 1), Camera.RotateUpPressed (4, 1, axis 2), Camera.RotateUpReleased (4, 0, axis 2), Camera.ForwardPressed (1, 1, axis 2), Camera.ForwardReleased (1, 0, axis 2), Camera.BackPressed (1, 1, axis 1), Camera.BackReleased (1, 0, axis 1), Camera.LeftPressed (0, 1, axis 1), Camera.LeftReleased (0, 0, axis 1), Camera.RightPressed (0, 1, axis 2), Camera.RightReleased (0, 0, axis 2), Camera.ResetPressed (6, 1), Camera.ResetPressed (7, 1), Input.WormSelectPressed (11, 1), Input.Jetpack.ForwardPressed (3, 1), Input.Jetpack.ForwardReleased (3, 0), Input.Jetpack.BackPressed (2, 1), Input.Jetpack.BackReleased (2, 0), Input.Jetpack.LeftPressed (0, 1), Input.Jetpack.LeftReleased (0, 0), Input.Jetpack.RightPressed (1, 1), Input.Jetpack.RightReleased (1, 0), App.Pause (12, 0), Input.FusePressed (4, 1), Input.FuseReleased (4, 0), Input.OpenPanelPressed (10, 1), Input.ToggleManualCamera (11, 1), Input.ManualCameraPitchPressed (6, 1), Input.ManualCameraPitchReleased (6, 0). Each entry is (action, enabled[, axis]); button actions mode 2, axis actions mode 1. The last three are added only when bit 0x01000000 of the context word at +188 (0x804b1788) is set.
